text:
anya (Docs): quick sync — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4010 is failing the preview. Two separate things: the prefetch dashboard panel 404s because it references an old metric name, and several observability snippets still use `cost_breakdown` + `trace_hook`. Can we triage?

tom (Eng): I pulled the preview logs. The dashboard JSON in docs/console/observability/prefetch.md points at metric `metrics.prefetch.latency_v0`. That metric was renamed during the telemetry migration. I'll update it to `metrics.prefetch.latency`.

rachel (Observability): I can take the panel JSON. Also noticed the panel has `prefetch.experimental: true` — is that intended in a public sample? recommend removing.

anya (Docs): good catch, remove experimental flag. Also the embedded live example references `/playground/embed.js` which now lives under `/playground/examples/embed.js`. Embed path needs update.

sam (SDK): for the snippet param rename (trace_hook -> tracehook) I propose a compatibility shim in snippet-runner for one release. I'll add a small normalize util and update docs snippets to the new param. Example shim: ```python
# snippet runner compatibility
def normalize_args(args):
    if 'trace_hook' in args and 'tracehook' not in args:
        args['tracehook'] = args.pop('trace_hook')
    return args
```

anya (Docs): can you also grep for `cost_breakdown`? I found it in two other examples under docs/snippets/observability/. We'll need to update those to `cost.annotation` as per the new schema.

tom (Eng): pushed a minimal fix for the metric id and removed the experimental flag. But CI still flagged a broken link to the playground file. I updated the embed path in my branch.

ci-bot: PR 4010  sample-link-check FAILED: 2 broken links, 1 snippet-lint warning. See https://ci.redwood-inference.net/ci/4010/logs

rachel (Observability): ran the dashboard schema validator locally after tom's change; valid now. I also adjusted the panel title to "Prefetch (sample)" to avoid implying prod settings.

sam (SDK): updated snippet tests to accept both keys during transition. Also added a unit test that asserts `tracehook` is used going forward. Will push shortly.

anya (Docs): small content nit: the prefetch snippet set batch_size: 512 which conflicts with our hosted guidance. Change to 64 or call out it's an example only.

tom (Eng): changed to 64 in the patch. Also added a short comment in the snippet: "// example only; tune for your workload".

ci-bot: snippet-lint: WARNING in docs/snippets/observability/prefetch.example.js: found deprecated key `cost_breakdown`

sam (SDK): I'll add a migration note in docs/migrations/observability-rename-2026.md describing the param renames and the SDK shim with a removal timeline.

anya (Docs): thanks. After all fixes pass CI let's merge and then run a quick backfill to add redirects for the playground path so external links don't break. Please add a changelog entry for the docs changes.

rachel (Observability): pushed a tiny formatting tweak to the panel JSON (ordering and minor comments). Validated.

sam (SDK): pushed shim + tests. Leaving a TODO to remove shim after two releases. Added changelog note.

ci-bot: PR 4010  sample-link-check OK; snippet-lint OK; preview deploy succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/branches/pr-4010

anya (Docs): preview looks good. I'll merge once CI completes and then create the redirect backfill PR. Great work team. :sparkles:

tom (Eng): thanks all.

rachel (Observability): cheers!

sam (SDK): :thumbsup:
